free_tier.stated: A CNY 20 no-threshold voucher is given for signup and verification. The large-model API is billed per token (for example DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 at CNY 2 per million input tokens), and compute points must be bought before using the model API.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI API format for the large-model service, with an API key created in the console
chaining: the CNY 20 signup voucher and the prepaid compute-point purchase bind before the per-token price

limits.value: CNY 20 no-threshold signup voucher; model API billed per token after buying compute points

identity_cost.detail: signup and verification are required for the voucher; the model API requires console registration and a prepaid compute-point purchase

reliability_note: compute points can only be bought with the cash balance of the ebcloud account, so a cash recharge precedes model API use

evidence.proved: signup and verification give a CNY 20 no-threshold voucher; the large-model API is billed per token and compute points must be bought before use
evidence.quote: 免费试用注册认证送20元无门槛代金券

notes: the only free allowance found is a CNY 20 signup verification voucher, not a standing free inference tier; the model API itself is prepaid
